title: Establish local-only smoke test layout and shared cleanup helpers
acceptance_criteria: Smoke test assets are placed in a documented local-only location and the chosen strategy keeps them out of normal Git workflows by default.
A shared helper module exists for starting processes, waiting on localhost readiness, and terminating spawned processes with bounded timeouts.
The helper logic is stdlib-first and does not require external services beyond localhost checks.
The local-only strategy is clearly documented for future runs and explicitly warns against commit/push.
